title: 10/10 Recommend!
text:
Incredible experience.  My tour guide, Lynn, was extremely knowledgeable and well-versed in Barcelona architecture.  Not only did I learn SO MUCH, the conversation was engaging and thoughtful.  It was my favorite part of my vacation!  10/10 recommend.  (Especially if you want to see the major landmarks without spending an entire day - we finished in under 2 hours).  

Note: exterior only. You do not go inside of the buildings with this tour.
author: marissacK3272XU
